descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-20 Rounding Dashboard · S23 Nursing Home dashboard tabs: switching Today's Visits / All Residents moves rows and counts, and list state does not leak in

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U3 In Nursing Home the dashboard comes with 'Today's Visits' and 'All Residents' tabs (UAT TC-20; TFA-92598 How it works 4) — gate: blocked: TFA-92598 in progress
  • U1 With patients in a mix of pending / in-progress / complete states, the dashboard counts (Total, Pending, In Progress, Complete) match the real patient-list state, in Hospital and in Nursing Home (UAT TC-20; TFA-92598 AC 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92598 in progress

Test design technique: State transition (state-transition) — Go through the steps in order (add → edit → delete, day 1 → day 2, offline → online) and check the state after each step.

Given Seeded Nursing Home: R1 In Today pending, R2 In Today pre-rounded, R3 not in today complete. The standard Hospital patient

When On the Nursing Home list: search for R1's name, change the sort order and select the All Residents tab. Open the dashboard. Tap its All Residents tab, then its Today's Visits tab

Then Opened from a filtered list, the dashboard still counts the In Today set: Total 2, Pending 1, In Progress 1, Complete 0, whatever the list's search, sort and tab. On the dashboard's All Residents tab the counts and rows are recorded (Q3: follow the tab, Total 3, or stay on In Today). …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): UAT TC-20 (tabs on the Nursing Home dashboard), TFA-92598 How it works 4 and AC 4, and the dashboard's own rule that it is independent of list search and the Today's Visits selection. Checkpoint 1 (opened from the filtered list): counts 2/1/1/0. Checkpoint 2 (dashboard All Residents tab): counts and rows recorded, judged after Q3. …

Where it ran: datasets (seeded data sets, list checks) on dev; test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S23 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-20.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev, lane datasets (datasets/results.json, screenshots not attached).

Test method: PW · Playwright script; secondary: AGENT · Browser agent — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev/datasets.
